history.created_by: RUN /bin/sh -c apt-get update     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends         ca-certificates                 libc6         libgcc-s1         libicu74         libssl3t64         libstdc++6         tzdata         tzdata-legacy     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit
RUN /bin/sh -c groupadd         --gid=$APP_UID         app     && useradd --no-log-init         --uid=$APP_UID         --gid=$APP_UID         --create-home         app # buildkit

RUN |3 SOURCE_REVISION=6f4475b2d3efee148e77dcf83ffe7437bd2f52fa BACKEND_SOURCE_REVISION=43ad1f3153326424e97d1e1fd1844a86598e99b9 EDGE_SOURCE_REVISION=be917a4082ff70ded322bd2ac4cf982014b2346e /bin/sh -c apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends supervisor python3 ca-certificates curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit

RUN |3 SOURCE_REVISION=6f4475b2d3efee148e77dcf83ffe7437bd2f52fa BACKEND_SOURCE_REVISION=43ad1f3153326424e97d1e1fd1844a86598e99b9 EDGE_SOURCE_REVISION=be917a4082ff70ded322bd2ac4cf982014b2346e /bin/sh -c node -e 'for(const name of ["SOURCE_REVISION","BACKEND_SOURCE_REVISION","EDGE_SOURCE_REVISION"])if(!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(process.env[name]??""))throw Error("Invalid build source identity: "+name)' # buildkit

COPY --chown=app:app README.md API_DOCUMENTATION.md AUTHENTICATION.md LOGIN_TROUBLESHOOTING.md IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md RENDER_DEPLOYMENT.md SYSTEM_DIAGRAMS.md ARCHITECTURE_DOCUMENTATION.md ./ # buildkit

ENV NODE_ENV=production ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Production API_ONLY=true BACKEND_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=render-bundle AAS_PROVISIONING_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3102/api/assets INTERNAL_TELEMETRY_SINK_URL=http://127.0.0.1:10000/api/internal/telemetry TELEMETRY_MIGRATIONS_DIR=/app/telemetry-migrations TRUST_PROXY=loopback RENDER_SERVICE_ROLE=all
HEALTHCHECK {Test:[CMD-SHELL curl --fail --silent http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-10000}/health/live || exit 1] Interval:15s Timeout:6s StartPeriod:1m0s StartInterval:0s Retries:3}
